verdict.rationale: Filee has no web API: the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. It does document its own programmatic interface, a CLI (`filee convert ... --to/--preset`) with `--json` output for scripts and defined exit codes 0-3. An agent or script can therefore drive conversions, but only through a command line, not a formal public API. missing for 10: an HTTP/REST or library API with a published spec (OpenAPI or SDK), API reference docs beyond the convert command, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the CLI works for agent automation.
